The outlet of exhaust equipment serving Type I hoods, shall be in accordance with Section 506.3.13.
   Exception: The minimum horizontal distance between vertical discharge fans and parapet-type building structures shall be 2 feet (609.6 mm) provided that such structures are not higher than the top of the fan discharge opening.
